A '''tangle gum tree''' is a tree found only in a dungeon in [[Daemonheim]]. It requires Level 1 [[Woodcutting]] to be chopped down and can yield 1-9 [[Tangle gum branches]] before depletion. Each log cut gives 35 experience. High [[complexity]] is required to find this tree whilst Dungeoneering.
